arguments.value: Henry Franklin Floyd, born in 1947 in Brevard, North Carolina, is a judge on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit and has served in senior status since December 31, 2021. He earned his B.A. from Wofford College in 1970 and his J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1973. Floyd served as a state representative in South Carolina from 1972 to 1978, practiced law in Pickens, South Carolina, from 1973 to 1992, and was county attorney for Pickens County from 1986 to 1992. He then served as a judge on the South Carolina Circuit Court for the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit from 1992 to 2003 before his appointment to the U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina in 2003 and later to the Fourth Circuit in 2011.
